title_sq: Okazion! Tek Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Okazion! Tek Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Dhe Orientim Perfekt !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 11 banim dhe ka siperfaqe totale 87.3 m2. title_en: Opportunity! At the Aviation Field, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!!
description_en: Opportunity! At the Aviation Field, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!! The apartment is located on the 11th residential floor and has a total area of ​​87.3 m2. It is organized in an entrance corridor that divides the premises, a spacious living room with a kitchenette and exit to the veranda, a matrimonial room, a children's room and a day toilet. The complex offers recreational areas, play areas for children and many services and facilities for a better life in the community. The area where it is located is one of the most preferred in Tirana due to the construction with a plan where the spaces and access are very well respected. The apartment is registered with ASHK.
